question: On iOS MapKit mainland base maps, should canonical WGS84 be rendered directly or transformed at the renderer boundary?
evidence: Read-only MKLocalSearch result country + raw coordinates, actual CoordinateConverter output, distance, screenshot of both markers relative to native POI labels. Hong Kong is a no-conversion control. Empty query is a deterministic failure case without a network request.
network_scope: One public Haodian-government search and one Hong Kong City Hall search, no login, credentials, GPS collection or paid model calls. Explicit --live-poi launch flag is required.
stop_rule: One request per case. Capture success or failure; stop after 45 seconds per query; no retries without new evidence.
